note: EXP-INT-001 VO_ONLY arm on mtn-r1-const-v1 (UE5 eight_figure_mountains_less_steep/Run_20260907_145801): the frozen stitching VO with the metric readout (h0_agl_m from the recording's settings.json, fx 512 px native) and the authoritative nadir-camera heading (world_stabilized_nadir_independent_yaw; heading_deg is the camera image-up azimuth, verified against cam_ue_q* at ingest), relocalization OFF. alignment_sidecar writes the persistent position under the identity alignment, i.e. the VO's own metric track — the baseline the INT arm is compared against on identical frames, scale, heading, estimator and readout.
